changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Crear cuentas abiertas' AS name, 'openAccount.create' AS code, 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver cuentas abiertas', 'openAccount.read', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar cuentas abiertas', 'openAccount.update', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar cuentas abiertas', 'openAccount.delete', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear cargos a cuenta abierta', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver cargos a cuenta abierta', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Anular cargos a cuenta abierta', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear abonos de deuda', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver abonos de deuda', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Anular abonos de deuda', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'OPEN_ACCOUNTS'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Emitir documentos de POS', 'pos.create', 'CASH' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver documentos de POS', 'pos.read', 'CASH' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver reporte de ventas', 'salesreport.read', 'CASH' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'openAccount.create', 'openAccount.read', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create', 'pos.read', 'salesreport.read');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ( 'openAccount.create', 'openAccount.read', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create', 'pos.read', 'salesreport.read') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'openAccount.create', 'openAccount.read', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create', 'pos.read', 'salesreport.read'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, bp.sub_module_id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.sub_module_id = ce.sub_module_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = bp.sub_module_id AND sm.code IN ('OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'CASH') WHERE ce.access_level IN ('FULL', 'READ_ONLY') AND bp.code IN ('openAccount.read', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'pos.read', 'salesreport.read') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, bp.sub_module_id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.sub_module_id = ce.sub_module_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = bp.sub_module_id AND sm.code IN ('OPEN_ACCOUNTS', 'CASH') WHERE ce.access_level = 'FULL' AND bp.code IN ('openAccount.create', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('openAccount.create', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ( 'openAccount.create', 'openAccount.read', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create', 'pos.read', 'salesreport.read') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code IN ( 'openAccount.create', 'openAccount.read', 'openAccount.update', 'openAccount.delete', 'chargeOpenAccount.create', 'chargeOpenAccount.read', 'chargeOpenAccount.delete', 'debtOpenAccount.create', 'debtOpenAccount.read', 'debtOpenAccount.delete', 'pos.create', 'pos.read', 'salesreport.read'));
